title: probe_peer: bare IPv6 IPs produce invalid HTTPS URLs
description: In discovery.rs::probe_peer (line 169), the URL is built as format\!("https://{}:{}", ip, port). When ip is a bare IPv6 address (e.g. fd7a:115c:a1e0::1), this produces 'https://fd7a:115c:a1e0::1:443/.well-known/jmap' which is not a valid URL (IPv6 must be bracketed: https://[fd7a:115c:a1e0::1]:443/). Hyper will fail to parse this URI and client.request() returns an error, causing probe_peer to return None. All Tailscale peers whose only reachable IP is an IPv6 address are silently unreachable via discovery. Fix: wrap ip in brackets if it contains a colon.
